prompts.name: hollow
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production animation sprite sheet for a Dutch calisthenics mobile app. Create ONE single image of exactly 3 columns by 2 rows of square frames, edge to edge, no gutters or borders, total landscape aspect ratio 3:2 (prefer 3072x2048). These six equal square frames are successive animation keyframes, read left to right on top row then bottom row. Every frame has IDENTICAL fixed camera, environment, body proportions, character identity and lighting. Frame-to-frame only the exercise pose changes. Each character stays fully inside its own cell with 12% safety padding on all sides. Artwork style: premium detailed hand-drawn animated graphic novel, confident dark ink contours, textured cel shading, sunlit Mediterranean leafy garden, olive and forest green ivy, aged sage green horizontal timber fence, mustard-yellow exercise mat on grass, warm sunlight and organic leafy shadows. Like the user's reference of an illustrated muscular male exercising in a garden. SAME adult athletic man in all frames: short dark brown hair, light stubble, muscular but natural physique, warm light skin, bare torso, charcoal grey above-knee shorts, barefoot. Anatomy must be correct. Rich illustrative finish, absolutely not stick figures, not flat vector clipart, not photographic. No text, no labels, no logos, no watermarks, no other people, no collage of different perspectives. Ground and mat must align perfectly in all six cells. Exercise: HOLLOW BODY ROCK. Side view, head to left, feet to right. Athlete lies in a shallow banana shape, arms straight overhead past ears, legs straight together, lower back stays rounded and in contact with the mat as he gently rocks. Frames 1-6: shoulders raised legs low; rock halfway back; shoulders lower legs higher; rock halfway toward front; shoulders higher legs lower; return intermediate. The torso and legs remain locked together as a single curved shape, NOT a sit-up, no sitting upright. Show the actual controlled rocking movement, using visibly different poses.

prompts.name: plank
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production exercise animation sprite sheet for the existing Dutch Workout app. Use the supplied image only as a STYLE, CHARACTER and ENVIRONMENT reference. Make a new exercise sheet: ONE landscape image, exact 3:2 aspect ratio, 3 columns by 2 rows of SIX equal SQUARE frames edge-to-edge, NO gutters or borders, ideally 1536x1024. Match the reference's detailed hand-drawn graphic-novel look, fine dark ink contours, textured shading, warm sunlight, lush leafy green garden, aged sage-green horizontal wooden fence and mustard-yellow exercise mat on grass. Same athletic adult man with short dark brown hair, light stubble, warm light skin, bare torso, charcoal shorts, barefoot. All frames use identical fixed camera, scale, framing, garden and mat position. Full person within each cell with breathing room: no cut-off hands, head or feet. Correct anatomy, exactly two arms and two legs. No text, labels, letters, watermarks, logos or UI. Frames are read top left to right then bottom left to right. Exercise: FOREARM PLANK HOLD. Fixed true side view, head LEFT, feet RIGHT. In EVERY frame the athlete holds a straight plank supported ONLY by both forearms and toes. Elbows directly underneath shoulders, elbows bent 90 degrees, BOTH forearms flat on mat and pointing left, hands relaxed, legs straight, neutral spine, aligned head-hips-heels. His chest and hips stay raised in ONE straight line, never sagging and never a pike. Six near-identical hold frames with very subtle breathing only, no push-ups, no hand plank, no leg raises.

prompts.name: bird-dog-pose
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE square exercise illustration, 1024x1024, for Workout. Input image 1 (garden sprite sheet): STYLE and CHARACTER reference only. Input image 2 (video frame): exact BIRD DOG POSE reference only. Create a SINGLE square scene, NOT a grid or sprite sheet. Re-draw the bird dog pose in image 2 in the detailed illustrated garden style of image 1: athletic adult male, short dark brown hair, light stubble, bare torso, charcoal shorts, barefoot, mustard yellow mat on grass, sage wood fence, lush green ivy, warm sunlight, fine dark ink contours and textured shading. Match the exact supporting and extended limb arrangement of the VIDEO image. The man faces RIGHT. His NEAR arm reaches straight toward RIGHT at shoulder height. His FAR palm is planted beneath the far shoulder. His NEAR KNEE and shin rest on the mat under the near hip. His FAR leg extends straight backward toward LEFT at hip height. These are opposite extended limbs and opposite supports. Keep the bent near leg fully visible from thigh through knee through shin and foot resting on mat; no missing shins. Horizontal neutral back, shoulders and hips level, head aligned, eyes down. Full body including BOTH hands and BOTH feet with 12% safe margin; fill most of square with athlete, don't crop as video did. Exactly two arms and two legs. No text from video, no clothes from video, no human resemblance to video demonstrator needed. No labels, arrows, borders, video controls or watermarks.
